sample_unit: individuals in EHR dataset (340 high-probability individuals chart reviewed)

links.outcome: Local EHR performance of FIND-FH flagged individuals checked by chart review against FH criteria
links.effect: Of 340 flagged, 20-32% met modified Simon-Broome or DLCN criteria for at least possible FH; 191 (56%) warranted outreach; 101 (53%) of those had LDL-C <190 mg/dL.
links.quote: In the reviewed cohort, 191 (56%) had enough clinical suspicion for FH to warrant outreach.

screen.reason: Evaluates external validation/performance of the FIND-FH machine learning model applied retrospectively to electronic health records to identify patients with familial hypercholesterolemia, accompanied by manual chart review.
